annotations.text:
These artboards match the live site: the hero mark cycles Digital, Data and Cyber, each drawing itself on; sector strip at 144px, centred; the wordmark lockup with the strapline flush beneath it; real contact details and ABN.

Two things the artboards can't show. The booking buttons are live links to cal.com on the real site. And the sector strip replaced client logos deliberately — government marks are restricted and client logos need written permission, so logos only go back if approvals come through.

The social share card, exactly 1200x630. The site serves this as public/og.png, rendered from the same design by `npm run og` — so if you edit this artboard, re-run that script to regenerate the file the site actually uses.
